name: The Great War
description: The Great War refers to an intense war that took place in Europe, the stronghold of powerful ability users, namely the Transcendents and Dame Agatha Christie's Order of the Clock Tower. It ended 14 years ago and expanded influence through countries outside of Europe.

name: Arahabaki Incident
description: The Arahabaki Incident or the Impostor Predecessor Incident refers to the incident of the Port Mafia's deceased predecessor appearing in Suribachi City near Yokohama, a plot made by Arthur Rimbaud to lure out the true Arahabaki, Chūya Nakahara. The root of the incident happened eight years ago at the end of the war, where a former national defense force was secretly researching an artificial ability-derived life-form known as Arahabaki.

name: King of Assassins Incident
description: The King of Assassins Incident is a major storyline in the Bungo Stray Dogs light novel/arc Storm Bringer. It centers on the legendary European assassin Paul Verlaine attempting to "liberate" Chūya Nakahara.

name: Dragon's Head Conflict
description: The Dragon's Head Conflict is an underground conflict in Yokohama between various underground organizations. It lasted for 88 days and is labelled as the darkest conflict in Yokohama's history.
outcome: The five orphans are adopted by Sakunosuke Oda.
Takasekai's leader is killed, leading to the organization's demise.

name: Reigo Island Seventeen-Victim Massacre
description: The Reigo Island Seventeen-Victim Massacre was the ultimate outcome of the Reigo Island Massacre, which led detective Yukito Ayatsuji to be labeled as a Special A-Grade Dangerous Skill User by the government.
outcome: Yukito Ayatsuji is marked as a Special A-Grade threat.
The Engineer evades arrest and murder.

name: Azure Banner Terrorist Incident
description: The Azure Banner Terrorist Incident is an event that killed over a hundred people. The mastermind behind the incident is the Azure King.

name: Maruzen Building Bombing
description: The Maruzen Building Bombing is a bombing incident caused by Motojirō Kajii.

name: The Incineration of Yokohama
description: The Incineration of Yokohama is an emergency plan carried out by The Guild to obtain the book.

name: Hostage Crisis Incident
description: The Hostage Crisis Incident is the event that led to the Armed Detective Agency being framed as the terrorist and murder organization known as the Decay of the Angel.
outcome: The Agency members were listed as terrorists.

name: Tyranny of Blood
description: The Tyranny of Blood refers to the period of terror and violence that occurred in Yokohama due to the Port Mafia's previous boss's rage.
